summary: Multi-slot consistency carrier. Per-slot emission = answer-position option distribution read from a frozen Qwen3-4B + small LoRA (rank 16). Edge = pairwise yes/no consistency potential from one of four sources. Factor graph decoded three ways (greedy / marginal / viterbi) and scored by joint exact-match against the exactly-known joint MAP.

carrier.planted_conflict_per_item: one local-vs-global conflict (per-slot greedy is globally inconsistent on one slot)

de_risk_subset.note: The decode numbers below were measured on a de-risk subset: 1 seed, cells T=3 k=3 C=2, 25 held-out items, 2-4 epochs. Not the full (T,k,C) x 3-seed grid.

decode_by_edge_source_decoupled_emission.description: decoupled emission (calibrated soft target, keeps correct option alive). joint exact-match.

decode_by_emission_oracle_edges.description: oracle edges (true constraint). joint exact-match, marginal/viterbi.

coupled_onehot.confound: coupled was trained one-hot toward gold, but gold on the bent slot is not determinable from the per-slot local prompt; this low number mixes collapse with an unlearnable target. The clean control is one-hot toward argmax(local_unary), not gold; not yet re-run.

viterbi_vs_marginal.reading: Viterbi adds about +0.04 over marginal; the gain over greedy comes from using the constraint at all (globality), not from the single-best-path form.

edge_judgment_auc.description: Can the model rank truly-consistent option pairs above inconsistent ones, via logp(yes)-logp(no)? AUC on the same per-pair consistency query.
edge_judgment_auc.wall: 1B-8B and several wordings all top out around 0.67; not a ladder.
edge_judgment_auc.decode_after_synthesis: Composing these ~2/3-accurate per-pair judgments into a full-item constraint decodes to only 0.04-0.08 joint exact-match (one mis-signed cell flips the joint).

elicitation_sweep_auc.description: elicitation method (M0 current query / M1 symbolic reframe / M2 few-shot M1) x decorrelated model. consistent-vs-inconsistent ranking AUC, 16 items, 288 pairs each.

source_files.note: Regularized from the internal run outputs.
